_comment: Per-county portal + parcel config. NOTHING county-specific lives in code. verified=true means the parcel-ID construction was confirmed against that county's appraiser on 3+ real records.

appraiser.name: BCPAO
appraiser.notes: search returns [{totalCount, account, parcelID, siteAddress, subdivisionName, ...}]; exact match has totalCount 1. account endpoint adds owner, mailingAddress, saleInfo/sales history, marketValue, parsed parcel components.

csvColumns._comment: Pinellas export has no U/Consideration/DocLegalDescription/CaseNumber columns; the legal rides in Comments. Case-class signals cannot fire.

parcelId.notes: Join verified via subdivision lookup: PINELLE PARTIAL REPLAT BLK A LOT 4, MILES PINES BLK H LOT 10, SHORE ACRES EDGEWATER SEC BLK 5 LOT 11 - all exact single matches. Condo units NOT joinable in v1 (PCPAO condo names differ from recorded names) - they route to review.

appraiser.name: PCPAO
appraiser.notes: Use the Sub/Condo quick search with the subdivision NAME; recorded names may be word-reordered vs PCPAO names (e.g. 'EDGEWATER SECTION OF SHORE ACRES' is 'SHORE ACRES EDGEWATER SEC') - try variants. Results include parcel ID + legal (match block/lot). Details page shows owner, site address, mailing address, sales history - map into the normalized parcel contract.
